layout: per neuron at (shard, offset), bytes long: Uint32 paths P, Uint32 vertices V, P x Uint16 path lengths, V x Int16 xyz (10 um), V x Uint16 geodesic distance from the soma (10 um), V x Uint8 compartment (1 soma, 2 axon, 3 dendrite, 4 apical)
coarse_layout: axons-coarse-<src>.bin: per neuron of that source in neurons.json order, cbytes long: Uint32 P, Uint32 V, P x Uint16 path lengths, V x Int16 xyz; terminal axon twigs under 300 um are left out
st_note: st: the Digital Brain portal's projectome class for ION neurons, a number for the prefrontal and hippocampus sets and IT-n / PT-n / CT-n for the whole cortex; names in subtype-names.json
tf_note: tf: axon terminals by named area or nucleus (cortical layers collapsed to the area), top 8 by share; rf: cell body region at the same level
